name: transom
description: A side pane for any app: one structured snapshot/act channel shared by people and the model.

allowedHosts.title: Allowed hosts
allowedHosts.description: Comma-separated hostnames the browser provider may visit. localhost and 127.0.0.1 are always allowed.

writePolicy.title: Write actions
writePolicy.description: How model-issued writes are confirmed: confirm (each), once (first per session), auto.

snapshotMaxChars.title: Snapshot character cap
snapshotMaxChars.description: Hard cap on a snapshot handed to the model.

hqDetail.title: HQ capture detail
hqDetail.description: Pixel density for hq frames: 1 (fast), 2 (default) or 3 (sharp). Higher detail costs CPU and disk.
